caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent, shallow bowl that appears to be made of glass. The bowl has a circular opening with a wide rim that tapers inward toward a narrower base. The glass is tinted with a yellowish-brown hue, and shading is used to indicate reflections and transparency, giving the impression of depth and a reflective surface. The bowl is centered on a plain, light-colored background, with no additional objects or elements present. The artist's signature, "V. VANCE," is written to the right of the bowl near the bottom of the image.
title: Small Glass Bowl
